proposal.description: Blend the trained base ranker score with a train-only collaborative reranking signal computed after model training.

baseline_noop.description: No post-hoc reranking; use the base model scores directly.

item_item_cowatch_blend.description: Add a small weighted item-item co-watch affinity term from the user's train positive history to candidate videos.

proposal.mechanism: This axis changes within-user ordering after training by injecting residual collaborative signal that is not represented by current menu axes, which only control training loss, in-model history encoders, architectures, and auxiliary tasks.
proposal.citation: Sarwar et al., 'Item-based Collaborative Filtering Recommendation Algorithms' (WWW 2001); also grounded in this run's measured pattern that broad additive signals outperform concentrated/reweighted training changes.
